pretreatment: annealed at 420°C for 20 mins in forming gas
surface_functionalization: a 0.3 nm thick TiN layer was deposited by thermal ALD prior to Ru deposition
evidence: A schematic of the wire processing flow is presented in Fig. 1. SiO 2 cores of height 25 nm and width 300 nm were patterned on 300 mm Si (100) wafers. Conformal Ru layers of thickness 8, 10, and 12 nm were subsequently deposited on the cores using atomic layer deposition (ALD) from (ethylbenzyl) (1-ethyl-1,4-cyclohexadienyl) Ru (0) (EBECHRu C 16H22Ru) and O2. Details of process chemistry and growth mechanism is published elsewhere. To improve adhesion between Ru and the SiO2 cores, a 0.3 nm thick TiN layer was deposited by thermal ALD prior to Ru deposition. The Ru deposition was then followed by an anisotropic ion-beam etch resulting in Ru wires on the sidewalls of SiO 2 cores.
